notes.title: Tiny Snow 6th Anniversary! Special Artwork Celebration
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35229112/675fd8d4f130ca52189fe4624db5fd429cd386c9.jpg[/img]

Thank you all for your continuous support of Class Tangerine（橘子班）!

In addition, card drops and the OST for Epiphyllum in Love are now available.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3540200/
If you already own the base game, you can get a discount when purchasing the bundle!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50852/

Also, our new game Puff Love Story has just launched its store page—be sure to add it to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3389860/Puff_Love_Story/

notes.title: English version updated!
notes.content:
We have updated English version for Dream Ending, translated by NaCeel and proofread by G.

You can also select language at "Properties - Language".
